description: This file defines the main React component for the '/app/journey/roadmap/page.tsx' route, implementing a roadmap visualization using a mind map and pathways for roles. It includes internal components, state management, and rendering logic for interactive nodes, edges, milestones, and UI controls, tailored specifically for the roadmap feature within the project.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Parses a raw string from local storage into a string array, handling JSON parsing errors.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string with a prefix.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between two bounds.

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns the current date in yyyy-mm-dd format.

methods.name: progressPill
methods.description: React component showing a progress percentage badge with color coding.

methods.name: statusChip
methods.description: React component displaying a milestone status badge with color coding.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a default RolePlan object for a given roleId with placeholder data.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads roadmap state (active role and plans) from local storage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap state to local storage.

methods.name: getMindMapModel
methods.description: Generates nodes and edges for rendering the mind map based on role and skill data.

methods.name: nodeSize
methods.description: Calculates the visual size (diameter) of a node.

methods.name: edgeStyle
methods.description: Determines the stroke style for an edge based on its weight and accent.

methods.name: MindMapNodeView
methods.description: React component for rendering an individual node in the mind map, handling hover, active states, and visual styling.

methods.name: MindMapSideCard
methods.description: Overlay side panel showing detailed info about a selected node.

methods.name: MindMapTooltip
methods.description: Tooltip component showing information about a node on hover.

methods.name: MindMapCanvas
methods.description: Main component rendering the interactive mind map with nodes, edges, controls, and interactions.

methods.name: RoadmapJourneyPage
methods.description: Main React page component for '/journey/roadmap', managing state for roles, plans, milestones, and rendering the tabs and components for mind map and pathway views.
